title: Chapter 176 The Future Of The Divine Dynasty
content:
Chapter 176 The Future Of The Divine Dynasty

Hearing the noise behind them, the three steady old guys panicked and stood up to greet them.

"Lord City Lord, you are here so soon."

Old Zhang was the first to step forward and said with a smile.

The man who came was Lu Daosheng.

"Lord City Lord, this time, I, Old Li, will not let you go."

The old patriarch of the Li family was in high spirits and looked radiant.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng immediately laughed and said, "Hahaha, it seems that you are all well prepared. Well, then I will accompany you to have a good drink."

In the corner, the ancestor of the Liu family said nothing.

How could he drink so much when he just woke up from the alcohol?

Here, he was the least qualified to speak.

Soon, the four of them sat down.

Lu Daosheng waved his hand, and the whole bamboo table was filled with wine jars with fragrant wine.

"Today, we won't go home until we are drunk!"

"We won't go home until we are drunk!"

......

"Haha, Lao Liu, you are not going to be able to do it again, are you?"

After three rounds of drinking, all four of them had bruises on their faces and their faces were red.

The ancestor of the Liu family was even more drunk and his mind began to blur.

"This wine is really powerful."

Lao Liu said this in a daze, and then fell on the table with a bang.

Seeing this scene, the other three people laughed.

This wine is really powerful. It was obtained by Lu Daosheng from the system store, and it almost ignores the realm.

No matter you are a god or an immortal, you will get drunk after drinking it.

At this moment, the ancestor of the Liu family has fallen down, which also aroused the fighting desire of the remaining three people.

Lao Li and Lao Zhang looked at each other, and then nodded secretly.

"Ahaha, Lord City Lord, thank you for your care over the years."

"Come, I, Lao Li, toast you a glass."

It's said to be a glass, but it's almost as much as half a jar of wine.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng did not refuse.

Gulp.

A glass of wine was already drunk.

"Come on, Lord City Lord, I'll toast you too!"

At this time, Lao Zhang raised his glass and said to Lu Daosheng generously.

And Lu Daosheng did not refuse either.

Gulp.

Another glass of wine was drunk.

Watching Lu Daosheng drink one glass after another, the two secretly rejoiced.

Hehehe, Lord City Lord, today we are going to avenge our previous shame.

However, Lu Daosheng naturally saw the purpose of the two people a long time ago, hehe, and still wanted to drink me down.

You two old guys are still too young.

Just like that, several more jars of wine went over.

"Burp~"

The old ancestor of the Li family burped and began to see stars.

"I, I can't do it anymore."

Looking at the old ancestor of the Li family like this, Lao Zhang looked a little ugly and turned his head to look at Lu Daosheng.

Although Lu Daosheng's face was red, he was still sober.

Damn!

Why can the city lord drink so much? !

It seems that I can only fight alone.

Lao Zhang looked tough and picked up the wine jar.

......

After a long time.

In the bamboo forest, three people were lying on the bamboo table, unconscious.

And the remaining person stood up directly.

Obviously, the person standing was the final winner this time.

"Tsk, that's it?"

Lu Daosheng's face was red and disdainful.

This time he didn't rely on the system to sober up, but because Lao Zhang and Lao Li took turns to pour him wine, he still used some tricks.

Lu Daosheng slowly took out a few peanuts from his sleeve and murmured with a smile: "Haha, if you three had a peanut, I might lose."

This time, peanuts won.

.........

At the same time, in the distant capital of the Divine Dynasty.

Two figures suddenly appeared in the void of the imperial capital.

It was Yan Lingyun and Gu Chen.

"Gu Chen?"

At this time, Yan Lingyun noticed that Gu Chen behind him was a little absent-minded.

Seeing this, Yan Lingyun hurriedly reminded him.

"Ah? We're here."

Gu Chen was stunned and suddenly realized that they had reached the imperial capital of the Divine Dynasty.

"Gu Chen, are you okay?"

Yan Lingyun hesitated.

"Do you want me to help you?"

Hearing this, Gu Chen waved his hand and said, "No,..."

At this moment, a figure suddenly came towards the void.

"Your Majesty, you are back."

When Mr. Zhou came to the void and saw Yan Lingyun, he was immediately overjoyed and hurriedly saluted respectfully.

Yan Lingyun nodded, "Pass on this emperor's order, everyone come to the hall to discuss matters."

"Yes, Your Majesty."

After Mr. Zhou left, Yan Lingyun signaled Gu Chen behind him with his eyes.

Then the two of them headed towards the direction of the Imperial Palace.

Dong~

A deafening bell sounded from the Imperial Palace.

Suddenly, the entire Imperial Palace trembled.

It's His Majesty, His Majesty is back!

After the incident with the Self-Eating Spirit Clan, the Empress never returned. Although there were several God Generals and Lord Zhou in charge, the Divine Dynasty would be without a master as long as His Majesty didn't return.

And now, His Majesty is finally back.

This made everyone in the Divine Dynasty excited.

It can be seen how great Yan Lingyun's prestige is in the Divine Dynasty.

After a while.

In the Divine Dynasty Hall.

Countless Divine Dynasty strongmen began to enter the hall one after another.

At this time, Gu Chen stood calmly in the hall.

At least he thought so.

At this time, a familiar figure entered his field of vision.

Suddenly, Gu Chen's heart trembled.

Mu Yu.

However, Mu Yu seemed not to see him, holding the staff and passing directly in front of him expressionlessly.

Gu Chen looked a little embarrassed.

Jian Xin also noticed Gu Chen, and Jian Xin frowned.

Walking to Gu Chen's side, Jian Xin glared at Gu Chen fiercely.

If Yan Lingyun was not sitting on it, she would have said a few words.

When everyone arrived, they all saluted Yan Lingyun.

"Okay."

"Has anything happened in the Divine Dynasty recently?"

Yan Lingyun sat on the dragon chair and asked in a low voice.

The Soul Devouring Clan is gone, so how can there be anything happening in the Divine Dynasty? Yan Lingyun asked this question just for the sake of meaning.

At this time, Zhou Lao stood up.

"Your Majesty, nothing has happened in the Divine Dynasty these days."

Hearing this, Yan Lingyun nodded slightly.

"In that case, let me tell you about what will happen next in the Divine Dynasty."

As soon as these words came out, everyone's expression suddenly became nervous.

They all knew that Yan Lingyun was the wife of the Lord of the Desolate City, and her strength seemed to be stronger than their majesty.

Now, the Divine Dynasty and the Desolate City have no enemies.

Rumors have even begun to spread in the imperial capital that the entire Divine Dynasty will be incorporated into the Desolate City.

Although it was stopped in time, it still made the Divine Dynasty a little shaken.

Incorporated into the Desolate City.

Some people are very happy because the treatment in the Desolate City is really good.

Who doesn't want to go to a better place to practice?

And some people are full of patriotism and firmly oppose the Divine Dynasty's annexation into the Desolate City, because in that case, wouldn't the Divine Dynasty be equivalent to destroying the country?

And now, Yan Lingyun talked about the future of the Divine Dynasty.

This made everyone in the Divine Dynasty nervous.

"It won't be long before this emperor will leave this world."

Yan Lingyun glanced at the ministers below, and then spoke in a calm voice.

Hearing this, the ministers were silent.

Seeing this, Yan Lingyun continued: "Divine Dynasty, this emperor will not give up, are you willing to leave with me?"
